notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 2 guide quests about the Supply Chain Illustrated (players who have unlocked over 60 recipes will automatically complete these two quests)
[*] Fixed a bug where the back mountain building relocation function could move buildings to unopened grid spaces
[*] Fixed a bug where scene loading could consume teleportation scrolls
[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect season and description for bundled lavender seeds
[*] Fixed a bug where repeated Dragon Boat Festival and Northern Country dialogues could cause scene loading errors
[*] Modified the tea recipes in the Tea Workshop to avoid duplication during research (this is a temporary solution and may be adjusted later)
[/list]

[list]
[*] Wuling Store now sells "sea fish," replacing the previous temporary substitute item "aquatic products."
[*] The settlement panel correctly counts seaside production in the total income.
[*] Winter plantation information now displays correct values.
[*] Fixed the plantation blueprint UI error.
[*] Fixed a bug where recruiting villagers in town scenes would incorrectly hide all random villagers' floating tooltip dialogs.
[*] Fixed the clipping bug with the bottom wall of the aquarium.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Updated the UI display effects for the villager recruitment page
[*] Starting now, Ami and Wuling have a chance to teach players the Oceanview Restaurant recipe when their affection reaches 4 hearts or above
[*] Pearl Clams now have a chance to yield pearls when consumed
[*] Increased the font size for villager task descriptions and villager names in the quest panel
[*] Increased the selling price for all fishing products
[*] Increased the profit income of the Oceanview Restaurant
[*] Beach area calculations now correctly use commas as separators
[*] Some unimplemented items have been disabled in random roadside NPC events
[*] Fixed a bug where the North Country Restaurant's right trash bin and warehouse trash bin were referencing the same entity data
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added new seaside building "Seaview Restaurant", unlocked at Town Level 3
[*] Added "Seaview Restaurant" to the game roadmap
[*] Added new researchable recipes: "Crispy Fried Fish Fillet", "Ginseng Golden Soup with Mushrooms and Scallops", "Golden Broth Jade Scallops", "Seafood Salad", "Sea Urchin Pasta", "Scallion Oil Chicken Rice", "Undersea Feast"
[*] Added "Crab" to the Aquaculture Farm
[*] Added "Scallop" to the Aquaculture Farm
[*] Adjusted the recipe for "Flying Wine", now requires sorghum + wheat + ambergris
[*] Slightly increased probability of random event NPCs appearing on streets
[*] Fixed misaligned tooltip for player-researched recipe materials in the manual
[*] Fixed unresponsive controller UI menu after triggering certain story events
[*] Fixed bug where items would be deducted even when refusing NPC purchase requests
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added teleport signs by the seaside that allow travel to designated expansion areas.
[*] After unlocking the portable storage talent, NPC item request quests will now automatically check both storage and backpack to complete tasks. Items are checked in reverse order from lowest to highest rarity, with higher rarity items granting multiplied monetary rewards.
[*] Fixed a bug where gifting villagers would sometimes incorrectly deduct higher-tier items instead of the selected tier items.
[*] Fixed an issue where aquarium wall items could incorrectly occupy furniture positions, causing data errors. Wall items can no longer be placed where furniture already exists.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where in extremely rare cases, players couldn't switch current production/sale items through manual or building interaction (caused by sorting algorithm error)
[*] Now the shipping box's food price multiplier correctly applies to all food category items
[*] Peach drink now requires tea leaves as ingredient (to distinguish it from peach jam)
[*] Changed default game initialization frame rate from 120 to 60 (to prevent overheating on some devices)
[*] Adjusted some morning settlement tutorial quest rewards to be directly placed in warehouse to prevent item loss due to save/load etc.
[*] Rewrote aquarium mouse highlight/fish tank floating info display algorithm - now displays correctly without misalignment
[*] Rewrote floating info hover animation algorithm (money consumption, stamina recovery etc.) - now displays correctly without misalignment
[/list]

[list]
[*] New Feature: At Town Level 2, players can now directly view all available villagers for recruitment from taverns in the commercial district at the Mission Board (left side of Town Convenience Store) and negotiate recruitment directly.
[*] Random NPCs in the commercial district and town streets now provide random events for villager recruitment, offering more early-game options to acquire villagers. Random recruitment consumes much less gift money compared to taverns.
[*] "Fresh Shrimp" now has a new UI.
[*] The manual now shows whether special villagers have been talked to that day.
[*] The R&D Bench no longer requires low-end chips to craft Smelting Furnaces.
[*] Fixed a bug where dialogues with seaside buildings sometimes failed to load building information correctly.
[*] Fixed incorrect material requirements for Aquatic Farm in the game roadmap.
[*] Fixed a bug where town fixed villagers would continue moving incorrectly when switching maps during recruitment.
[*] Fixed incorrect collision bodies and sorting layers for the Crab Tank in the Aquarium.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added new coastal building "Aquaculture Farm", unlocked at Town Level 3
[*] Added new villager type "Aquaculture Worker", recruitable from Town Level 3
[*] "Aquaculture Farm" produces "Fresh Shrimp", "Sea Cucumber", "Sea Fish", and "Mystery Deep-Sea Fish"
[*] Added "Aquaculture Farm" to game roadmap
[*] Added "Aquaculture Farm category" to manual panel
[*] Added "Aquaculture Worker category" to manual panel
[*] Temporarily significantly increased output of all coastal buildings (as they currently lack Goddess Blessing bonuses). Output will be adjusted back after Goddess Blessing updates include relevant talents.
[*] Fixed display/text errors for Specialty Shop outputs in game roadmap, including multilingual display issues
[*] Optimized coastal wave seam issues
[*] Improved performance when displaying large coastal maps
[/list]

[list]
[*] Fixed the bug with incorrect default zoom distance in the top-down view panel for Qiankun Bag, Commercial Street, and Back Mountain movable buildings.
[*] Fixed the bug where a very few objects in villas and private homes could not be correctly returned to storage.
[*] Fixed the sound effects bug at the salvage station.
[*] Optimized the water surface lighting at the salvage station.
[*] Now furniture in villas can be placed in private homes.
[*] Added transparent lighting fixtures to private homes and villas.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added new coastal building "Salvage Station", available to build at Town Level 2
[*] Added new staff type "Diver", available to recruit at Town Level 2
[*] Added 5 new items with corresponding UI: "Sea Urchin", "Deep Sea Mud", "Pearl", "Ambergris", "Deep Sea Spice Sand"
[*] Added Salvage Station to game roadmap
[*] Fixed incorrect tooltip about Salt Pans in game roadmap
[*] Added Diver category to Manual panel
[*] Added Salvage Station category to Manual panel
[*] Modified recipes for Facial Mask, Essence Mask, and Secret of the Deep Sea
[*] Changed construction requirements for Salt Pans: reduced Wood cost, added Stone cost
[*] Optimized game compression method, significantly improving initial loading speed
[*] Fixed bug where some bushes in Town and Shopping District would flicker incorrectly when swaying
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added tea extract to the game roadmap
[*] Fixed a bug with incorrect configuration of the capelin fish tank
[*] "Bait" and "Crushed Jade" now correctly appear in the warehouse item filter categories
[*] Added zoom functionality to the farm Qiankun Bag's top-down view
[*] Slightly enlarged the hover UI size of the farm Qiankun Bag
[*] Fixed a bug where aquarium walls might block the entrance for players with old save files
[*] Fixed a bug where some aquarium automatic door frames were not displaying correctly
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added a construction hint panel for seaside buildings
[*] Added a new tutorial quest for building seaside salt pans
[*] Added a weekly limited purchase item "Jade Fragments" to the Goddess Shop
[*] Added divorce functionality: divorce by gifting "Jade Fragments" to a spouse (irreversible effect, locks affection, and prohibits re-proposal to the same target)
[*] Added 5 talent traits for salt pan workers
[*] Fixed text errors in English and Japanese descriptions for salt pans
[*] Fixed a bug where switching the active state in the Golden Tree backpack did not affect actual calculations
[*] Fixed a UI configuration error for "Pray for Snow" in the Goddess Shop
[*] Fixed a UI configuration error for "Pray for Luck" in the Goddess Shop
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added Golden Tree UI
[*] Added collectible "Golden Tree", which can be purchased from the Goddess Shop. When the Golden Tree collectible is activated, it automatically harvests fruit trees and grapes on the daily settlement page, significantly optimizing the performance of the original Golden Tree harvesting method.
[*] Removed the "Golden Tree" item from the Goddess Shop (existing Golden Trees will not be affected, but the acquisition method has been disabled).
[*] Fixed a bug where player-customized recipes could not be displayed correctly in the handbook and building details page when subscribed to Workshop language packs.
[*] Fixed a bug where the text "Rarity" in player-developed recipes in the handbook was not properly localized.
[*] Fixed a bug where automatically laid floors during map expansion would not be correctly saved to the save file.
[*] Slightly increased the trigger range for building constructions near the beach.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Added new salt pans near the coast; salt pans can now be built close to the shore.
[*] Added new salt workers who can be recruited in the tavern.
[*] Added two new items: Refined Sea Salt and Dusk-Dawn Sea Salt.
[*] Added a coastal production section to the daily settlement.
[*] Added salt pans to the game roadmap.
[*] Added a coastal buildings category to the manual.
[*] Added a salt worker category filter button to the manual.
[*] Fixed an erroneous action command where Jingtian would fade and disappear after moving to the target point at 7 AM.
[*] Fixed a bug where the bottom row of the aquarium walls might display incorrect layering.
[*] Adjusted the recipe compositions for the following items to reduce redundant recipes and lower the difficulty of recipe development for players. Existing researched recipes in player saves will not be affected: Yangchun Noodles, Scallion Oil Noodles, Fried Prawns, Soy Milk, Peanut Butter, Fermented Rice, Apple Jam, Lemon Jam, Tomato Jam, Lychee Jam, Peach Jam, Blueberry Jam, Special Chili Powder, Fruit Juice, Ginger Essential Oil, Grape Seed Essential Oil, Soy Sauce, Traditional Soy Sauce, Stinky Tofu.
[/list]

[list]
[*] The layout panel has added an automatic floor placement function. When the button is checked, walls at the target location will be automatically removed and floors will be automatically placed during expansion.
[*] Added the ability to open the Mod file path in the Mod management panel.
[*] Fixed a bug where Mods would not take effect when entering the game by loading a save or starting a new game.
[*] Fixed the issue of misplaced points in some Northern Country storylines, which caused incorrect display layers in the Northern Country.
[*] Fixed the issue of misaligned collision bodies for villa walls.
[/list]

[list]
[*] You can update the Mods you created and subscribed to in the Mod Manager.
[*] The Mod Manager now supports controller and keyboard input.
[*] Optimized the input logic for parts of the game's initial interface.
[*] Rewrote the loading and activation mechanism for character portrait Mods, improving performance during game startup when loading these Mods.
[*] Fixed a bug where numerical Mods were not applying correctly.
[*] Addressed an issue where indoor wall collisions would occasionally fail.
[/list]

[list]
[*] A Mod manager has been added, which supports functions such as manual sorting and enabling/disabling Mods.
[*] On the grid of the building details page in the manual, a function has been added to view the specific content and quantity of consumed materials by hovering the mouse.
[*] The bug that the stamina bar did not refresh correctly after a short rest has been fixed.
[/list]

[list]
[*] The Creative Workshop has added function interfaces related to game values.
[*] The Mod upload interface has added the function of uploading value Mods.
[*] The Creative Workshop has added a Russian language pack.
[*] The Creative Workshop has added a Portuguese (Brazil) language pack.
[*] A prompt window for automatically jumping to the multi - language Mod pack in the Creative Workshop under some language environments has been added.
[*] Fixed the bug that modifying the mouse style in the manual settings has no effect.
[*] Fixed the bug that the spouse does not automatically move after sleeping in the villa.
[/list]

[list]
[*] A Korean language pack has been added to the Steam Workshop.
[*] Fixed a bug where the quest panel would not initialize and refresh in the correct language when multiple language mods were subscribed to.
[*] Fixed a bug where the quest panel would not initialize and refresh in the correct language after switching languages in the manual settings.
[*] Fixed an error in the multilingual configuration of villager recruitment names.
[/list]

A Turkish language pack has been added to the Steam Workshop.

Fixed a bug that caused an error when opening the villager recruitment panel in the tavern while using a subscribed language pack.

Fixed a bug where the buff status floating window displayed incorrect prompts.

Fixed a bug in the display of building production/sale targets.

Fixed a bug where ModConfig would be incorrectly overwritten when uploading portrait mods to the Steam Workshop.

Modified the default farm construction configuration when the controller is connected.

Provided two sets of controller planting modes: grid-based farming or automatic snapping and splicing in free mode.

Added a resolution option for Steam Deck. When players launch the game on Steam Deck, the settings page will have a dedicated resolution option to optimize the gaming experience on Steam Deck.

New Steam Deck players with fresh saves will automatically apply the new resolution settings, while players with old saves need to manually switch the resolution in the settings.

Fixed the problem that the last two tasks (daily turnover exceeds x) in the tutorial storyline would cause the game to freeze (this only occurred in old save files and has been fixed).

Fixed the bug that the side views of scarves and eyes in the character creation interface couldn't be previewed correctly.

Fixed the positioning bug in the initial farm storyline caused by replacing the log cabin.

Fixed the bug that a new save file would show a loading error if there were no buff states.

Optimized the villager movement algorithm. Now, when the player gets close to a villager, the villager will pause its movement.

Fixed the bug of incorrect dialogue positioning in the home after the wedding.

Optimized the problem of the joint between the interior walls and the floor. Now they can be aligned correctly.

Optimized the sorting hierarchy problem of the aquarium walls. Now, the customers in the aquarium won't pass through the models.

Optimized the problem that villagers would appear in advance when switching scenes (the problem of ghostly flickering).

Fixed the bug that the texture display of the rarest egg in the claw machine was incorrect.

Fixed the bug that the claw of the claw machine would occasionally fly out of the screen.

Fixed the problem of incorrect arrow display in the task system (when accepting a task while the task panel is minimized, the task switching arrow would appear incorrectly).

Fixed the bug that the buildings just constructed in the back mountain couldn't be moved.

Fixed the bug that the grass display was incorrect after moving buildings in the back mountain.

Optimized the sorting hierarchy problem of Beiguo.

Canceled the function that clicking the left mouse button near the R&D station could bring up the blueprint panel to prevent incorrect clicks after R&D failures.

Canceled the function that clicking the left mouse button near the cooking station could bring up the cooking panel to prevent incorrect clicks after cooking.

Adjusted the position of the farm mailbox.

Adjusted the position of the shipping box.

Optimized the collision bodies of many farm objects. Now they have more compact and smooth collision bodies.

Added the wind chime sound effect when going out of the level 1 home.

Adjusted the triggering order of some storylines in Beiguo's restaurant to prevent conflicts.

Redesigned the appearance of the log cabin in the first stage of the farm.

Fixed the bug where repeatedly loading save files would cause the duration of buff states to be incorrect or even disappear directly.

Expanded the list of favorite items for each villager.

Fixed the schedule bug of the marriage partner on Chinese New Year's Eve.

Now, the first row of the backpack is fixed and does not participate in automatic sorting.

Now, the number keys 4, 5, 6, and 8 on the numeric keypad can also control the movement of the protagonist. (Note that the movement controlled by the numeric keypad is of the toggle type, which means that once you click a key, the protagonist will keep moving until you input other movement commands or open a panel.)

Now, the shop of the gambling vagrant no longer requires you to win 10 times to open.

Reduced the purchase restrictions for the gambling vagrant's shop.

Fixed the bug where the key instructions for the "Three Balls in One Cup" game were incorrectly displayed.

Fixed the bug of the incorrect key prompt box in the gambling mini - game.

Added a function to reset all keys to their default settings on the custom key panel.

Now, on the warehouse page, you can hold down the Ctrl key to extract half of the target items.

Now, on the warehouse page, you can hold down the Shift key to extract a fixed 100 pieces of the target items.

Changed the back view to a side view in the game's initial character - creation interface.

Fixed a bug that might have prevented players from entering a new day, possibly caused by a communication failure with Steam.

Rewrote the line - break code for English text in dialogues, reducing incorrect line - breaks during conversations.

Optimized the display effect of the floating dialog box. Now, it will definitely not exceed the screen range, and its appearance position and display size are restricted.

Optimized the problem of incorrect line - breaks in the English text of the task floating window.

Fixed the problem of the incorrect display hierarchy of Beiguo in the cooking festival.

Fixed the problem of the incorrect frame animation display hierarchy of Beiguo when working in the restaurant.

The number of times to gain the friendship of seagulls is reduced to 20 times of feeding fries (originally 30 times).

Removed the novice - guidance task: clearing any debris below the farm (to avoid unnecessary misunderstandings).

Adjusted the fade - out speed of the confirmation panel (accelerated).

Optimized the collision body of the black market.

Optimized some interaction logics. For example, you can interact with the fruit trees in the town and rummage through the trash cans by clicking the left mouse button.

Binding custom keys to the space bar is no longer allowed, as it will lead to unpredictable errors and conflicts.

Added 6 new villager - commission tasks (related to fishing).

Rewrote the settlement logic for the items submitted in the villager - commission tasks. Now, it will preferentially deduct the items with lower levels in the backpack in a recursive manner.

Added a water - accumulation effect to the commercial - street plot, which will appear on rainy days.

Now, the task acceptance panel and the task panel will display the total quantity of the target required items in both the warehouse and the backpack.

Optimized the display effect of the task acceptance panel and the triggering range of the interactive 
buttons.

Added a new type of ground lighting fixture (stone lamp) to the aquarium.

Now, customers will not be generated in the aquarium after 9 p.m. (21:00).

Fixed the layer errors and collision body errors of some ground lighting fixtures.

Fixed the bug that the guiding page wouldn't pop up correctly when entering the aquarium for the first time.

Fixed the bug that the buttons on the guiding page wouldn't respond correctly.

Added 6 new types of doors to the self-owned house.

Added a button on the arrangement panel that can lock the movement of the screen edge.

When the town reaches Level 2, players can construct an aquarium at the seaside construction site. The aquarium generates continuous profit through ticket sales.

37 new floor designs added.

16 new aquarium-themed wall designs added.

24 new wallpaper patterns added.

25 unique fish tanks added (each corresponds to fish obtainable via player fishing).

8 types of automatic doors for aquariums added.

18 new lighting fixtures added (categories: ceiling-mounted, wall-mounted, and floor-based).

22 new aquarium wall decorations added.

The town level-up panel now notifies players about aquarium construction requirements upon reaching Level 2 (requires 3 types of construction materials).

Daily income calculations now include aquarium ticket revenue.

Fixed an issue where briefly right-clicking to remove indoor walls/furniture could accidentally remove adjacent objects. Long-press removal remains unaffected (added a 0.2-second built-in trigger delay).

Added a personal favorability plot for Dongqing (with a favorability level of 4 hearts).

Optimized the situation where when players have the "Portable Warehouse" talent, the selection panel for ornaments on the arrangement table in the self-owned house will automatically load the table decorations in the warehouse during initialization.

Fixed the problem that the backpack expansion panel couldn't correctly receive keyboard and gamepad inputs.

Modified the default interactive key of the backpack expansion panel.

Added key sound effects to the backpack expansion panel.

Slightly adjusted the dialogue of the guiding plot when entering the Rose Office for the first time.

Fixed the problem of character misplacement in the North Country when triggering the plot upon first entering the North Country Restaurant.

Optimized the collision volume of some parts of the North Country Restaurant and changed it to an oval shape.

Optimized the display effect of key inputs on the teleportation panel and added indication arrows.

Fixed the bug that Melody Emoji didn't play correctly in the introduction plot of the Rose Research Table.

Fixed the bug that the key prompt box of the recruitment panel didn't correctly follow the panel to hide and appear.

Added sound effects to the button for modifying the food quantity on the recruitment panel.



Guys, the production of the aquarium is coming to an end. If everything goes smoothly, the aquarium will be implemented by the seaside within a week!

Added a default gamepad selection panel. When players first enter the game and have a gamepad connected, they can choose whether to use the gamepad or the keyboard and mouse. (This page will only appear once for each save file. Even if a choice is made, it can be modified later in the Manual => Settings.)

Optimized the fading - out speed of the mask on the game start interface.

Optimized the control logic of the game start interface. It won't respond to operations when the mask hasn't fully faded out or when there are other panel prompts.

Optimized the key - input and gamepad - input logic for the warehouse filtering. Previously, the logic wouldn't respond when moving to the last button. Now, it will automatically return to the front.

Optimized the conflict issue of the item prompt floating box during warehouse filtering.

Added interactive sound effects to the warehouse panel.

Added some missing key - input interactive sound effects to the manual panel.

Added key - input interactive sound effects to the game start interface.

The TV interaction weather forecast panel in the self - owned house now supports key - input and gamepad - input interactions.

The selection panel for ornaments on the arrangement table in the self - owned house now supports key - input and gamepad - input interactions.

Added key prompts to the selection panel for ornaments on the arrangement table in the self - owned house.

Added a personal favorability plot for Lixue (4 hearts).

Optimized the issue that in special cases, when clicking continuously during the planting process, plants could be planted in positions where it is not allowed.

Added a background music (BGM) for spring.

Added a background music (BGM) for summer.

Optimized the appearance of the wooden columns in the self-owned house.

Added two options for the columns in the self-owned house.

Added 15 new types of wallpapers for the self-owned house.

Tried to fix the bug that the lower slots don't refresh correctly when removing indoor furniture in some cases.

When stealing crops, only the friendship points of the first villager who discovers it will be deducted now.

Fixed the bug that the traveling merchant Sofia would also be included in the judgment when stealing crops.

Fixed the bug that the traveling merchant Sofia would also be included in the judgment when rummaging through trash cans.

Optimized the problem that the mouse - determination point is lower than the actual screen display when removing indoor furniture.

Fixed the bug that the Layout Panel couldn't use the R1 button to place objects when a gamepad was connected.

Fixed the issue that the B button on an Xbox gamepad didn't respond and had conflicts.

Fixed the problem that in some cases, there was a conflict between the keys and the shortcut slots for using items.

Added key press sound effects to the Quest Panel.

The Shipment Box panel now supports keyboard and gamepad inputs.

Added key operation prompts to the Shipment Box panel.

Added key press sound effects to the Shipment Box panel.

Added a shortcut key for opening the Qiankun Bag panel with a gamepad.

The Qiankun Bag panel now supports keyboard and gamepad inputs.

Added the default shortcut key "V" for the Layout Panel.

The key - binding modification list allows customizing the shortcut key for the Decoration Panel.

Added the default shortcut key "N" for the Qiankun Bag panel.

The key - binding modification list allows customizing the shortcut key for the Qiankun Bag.

Added mouse - enter button prompts for the Layout Panel and the Farm Qiankun Bag panel.

Now, when the game starts or a save file is loaded, unassigned shortcut keys will be automatically assigned to the corresponding default keys.

Fixed a bug where the inventory and time windows would not resume normal display after the gamepad prompt window disappeared upon loading a save file.

Added a shortcut key for the gamepad to open the decoration panel.

Now, when moving the screen with the left joystick on the interior decoration panel, the currently selected frame will not move simultaneously.

Modified the highlighted selection effect for keyboard and gamepad inputs on the cooking panel.

The cooking panel will automatically scroll to the view position of the target dish when it is selected.

Added keyboard and gamepad key prompts to the cooking panel.

Fixed a bug on the prompt panel after cooking on the cooking panel, where clicking "Confirm" with the keyboard or gamepad would cause repeated cooking.

Added sound effects for selecting dishes on the cooking panel.

The key selection on the recipe panel will correctly start from the first grid.

Added sound effects for the selection buttons on the recipe panel.

Added keyboard and gamepad key prompts for the research bench production panel.

Added sound effects for selecting items with keyboard and gamepad inputs in the inventory.

Fixed a sound effect bug when farming.

Optimized the key logic of the warehouse filtering buttons.

Added fish filtering to the key filtering logic of the warehouse.

Fixed a bug where the initial guiding storyline might not end correctly when using a gamepad.

Modified the key - input logic of the recipe development panel.

Added keyboard and gamepad key prompts to the recipe development panel.

Improved the highlighted selection display effect of the recipe development panel.

Fixed a bug in the key - input for selecting the recipe illustration in the recipe development panel.

Fixed a bug where the gamepad prompt box on the warehouse page conflicted with the filtering buttons.

The newbie guiding panels (planting, recipes, fishing, road signs, etc.) can now correctly receive keyboard and gamepad inputs.

The Mid - Autumn Festival mooncake panel can now correctly receive keyboard and gamepad inputs.

Added keyboard and gamepad key - input prompts to the game's initial interface.

Modified the highlighting effect and logic of the character - creation page at the beginning of the game.

Fixed a bug where the game's initial interface failed to correctly respond to key and gamepad inputs.

Fixed a bug in the incorrect preview of the protagonist's back view on the game's initial interface.

Added a personal favorability storyline for XvDong (4 hearts).

In the game roadmap, you can now enter and search for the recipe you want to find, and the target 
recipe will be highlighted.

Modified the idle frame animation during the first half of the Rose (scene).

Added 4 new guiding quests (related to developing recipes).

Added a guiding quest for purchasing items from the Traveling Merchant Sophia.

The negotiation page of the Villager Tavern now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

Fixed a bug that, due to unexpected circumstances, the fished-up fish couldn't be correctly picked up under special situations.

Fixed a bug that when there were no tables or beds in the player's home, the marriage partner would appear in the wrong position.

Added one YinChun personal favorability plot (8 hearts).

The part-time job selection panel now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

The villager recruitment page now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

The construction page of buildings in the Back Mountain now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

The construction page of buildings in the Commercial Street now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

The construction page of buildings in the town now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

The panel of the Vagrant Gambling Mini - game now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

Optimized the misalignment issue of the item placement slots on the Vagrant Gambling Mini - game panel.

The panel of the Claw Machine Mini - game now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

Added input prompts for the controller and keyboard keys on the Black Market Limited Items Sale Panel.

Added key - press sound effects to the panels of the Black Market Limited Items Sale, Scratch - off Lottery, Collection Draw, and Three Immortals Return to the Cave games.

Fixed the bug that the confirmation button on the Black Market Limited Items Sale Panel couldn't correctly receive mouse clicks.

Fixed the bug that, under special circumstances, the Botanist achievement couldn't be correctly obtained when unlocking all plant shipments for the first time.

Added 1 Spring Festival personal favorability plot (4 hearts).

Replaced Smile Emoji with Melody Emoji in some storylines.

Lamps can now be placed in unexpanded grid slots in the player's home.

Fixed an issue where the effects of the random events "Talent Shortage" and "Recruit Talents" were reversed.

Improved the visual design of the Black Market limited items panel.

Updated the particle effects for selecting Black Market limited items.

The Black Market limited items panel now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

The Black Market limited items panel now supports 16:10 resolution.

The Black Market collection lottery minigame now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

The Black Market "Three Immortals Return to the Cave" minigame now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

The Black Market scratch card minigame now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

Story dialogue options now support keyboard and controller inputs.

The collection rewards page now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

Fixed a bug where the Sign teleportation panel would fail to auto-scroll the view correctly based on the current selection when using keyboard inputs.

Fixed an issue where the Sign tutorial prompts would repeatedly appear.

Fixed a bug causing fishing bonuses to not be affected by the Absorption Talent.

Fixed the notification for collecting items from the claw machine.

Keyboard and input controls are now supported for selecting options in story dialogues.

Keyboard and input controls are now supported for the Sign teleportation panel.

Added a tutorial guide for using Signs.

Slightly increased the recovery time after completing a fishing action to prevent unexpected consecutive clicks.

Reworked fishing sound effects and fixed bugs causing audio conflicts and inconsistencies.

Added 1 personal favorability plot in the North Country (8 hearts).

Updated the icon for the Luck buff.

Updated the icon for the Fishing buff.

The farm teleportation panel now supports 16:10 resolution.

An additional prompt will appear when there’s only one mirror in the farm teleportation panel.

The farm teleportation panel opened via the Ends of the Mirror of Distant Proximity now supports keyboard and controller inputs.

Added a personal favorability plot in the North Country (4 hearts).

Fixed the bug that caused the teleportation panel of the "Ends of the Earth" mirror to fail to load data correctly after loading the save file.

Fixed the bug that career data would not be correctly loaded into the corresponding save file data after loading the save file.

Optimized the abnormal performance of the weather system (raindrops and snow) caused by teleportation after using the road sign.

Fixed the bug that when obtaining fish catches for the first time, if it is a fish of high rarity, the record of obtaining it at the common level will be wrongly written into the career record.

Fixed the bug in the schedule of Fangcao from 19:00 to 22:00. Now, Fangcao will correctly appear on the second floor of the Chinese medicine store.

Now, when the game starts or the village save is loaded, it will detect the problem of incorrect occupation of villagers' huts caused by some reasons, and the status of empty huts will be corrected properly.

Now, the calculation method of the material consumption reduction for farm buildings in the talent system has been changed to an additional 50% reduction on the final consumption.

Fixed the bug that the golden koi couldn't be caught correctly when fishing in the pond at the upper - left corner of the Northern Country Restaurant in the town.

Reset the UI of the little octopus.

Corrected the description error of the red wine recipe introduction.

Corrected the description error of the Starry Sky Fruit.

Added 4 sofas facing backward. They can be purchased from Xudong's Favorability Store.

Now the recruitment panel supports a resolution of 16:10.

Added a new function: When the town is at level 4 or above, you can spend prosperity points to immediately refresh the list of candidates to be recruited in the recruitment tavern (the prosperity points to be spent are calculated according to the number of refreshes and the current town level).

Fixed the bug that special wall-mounted objects (such as those occupying three or more vertical grids) would cause conflicts with other objects in the scene.

Fixed the bug that some buttons on the self-owned house layout panel could not be loaded correctly.

Fixed the text errors of a bundle of peanuts and a bundle of blueberries.

Fixed the bug that the gashapon in the claw machine sometimes did not settle correctly.

Rewrote the code for laying out walls, floors, and wallpapers in the self-owned house, alleviating the lag problem caused by continuous clicking.

The "Pray for Snow" item can now be purchased at the Goddess Store, but it is only available for purchase in winter.

Slightly adjusted the UI layout of the decoration panel.

Now, when removing a wall, if there are wall decorations at the wall's location, the wall can no longer be removed directly.

Added a deduction reminder for operations such as placing items in the self - owned house, building new walls, or floors.

Modified the placement rules for indoor wall - mounted items. Now, wall - mounted items no longer occupy the placement identification of floor items.

Optimized the lag problem caused by repeated cyclic compilation that might occur when placing indoor decorations under special circumstances.

Reduced the screenshot resolution in the save file to ease the pressure of cloud save synchronization.

Optimized the collider of the door of the self - owned house.

Now, the marriage partner will prioritize looking for a double bed instead of a single bed.

Fixed the bug that might cause errors in the self - owned house data when expanding the villa scene map.

Fixed the bug of incorrect text description for chili pepper seeds.

Fixed the bug that some system setting parameters (such as language parameters) were not refreshed correctly when loading different save files.

Fixed the bug where buttons with null parameters were loaded when the farm teleportation panel was loaded.

Starting now, the Steam Cloud Save function has been enabled for the Windows version.

Added an in - game prompt for enabling cloud saves.

Fixed the bug that the seagull animation by the sea was not played correctly.

Fixed the bug that the time in the Lakeside Cottage didn't flow normally.

Now, when removing crops in seed form, the seeds will be returned.

Now, the shrubs in the town can be picked for berries periodically.

Optimized the parameters of the trigger colliders on both sides of the farm.

Fixed text errors in some repeatable - planting seeds.

The gambling mini - game panel now supports a 16:10 resolution.

Fixed the bug where, under special circumstances, garbage could still be obtained even when there was a garbage bin.

Fixed the bug where, during the daily settlement, if the town level was upgraded, it would appear simultaneously with the settlement panel.

Optimized the daily random event prompt window so that it should appear only after the settlement panel is closed.

Fixed the bug that the acquisition probability of some fish catch rarities was higher than expected.

Fixed the bug that the crafting panel didn't correctly refresh the consumed materials.

Fixed the bug of miscalculation of consumed materials on the crafting panel.

Now, the consumed materials on the crafting panel will show the quantity of items consumed from both the backpack and the warehouse.

Changed the acquisition condition of the fishing rod with Goddess' Blessing to collecting 25 different golden - star fish catches.

Now, the Qiankun Bag can move all vine - like plants.

Corrected the quantity of cuisine statistics in the "Career" section of the manual.

Added a purchase reminder email from Zhongnan regarding animal feed.

Now, the tea trees in the town can be picked for tea leaves periodically.

The warehouse sorting will correctly arrange items of the same category according to their rarity.

The backpack sorting will correctly arrange items of the same category according to their rarity.

Added the sound effect of the fish taking the bait while fishing.

Now, the game roadmap will correctly display all the goods sold in the specialty store.

Fixed the bug that caused the teleportation of the Teleportation Mirror in the farm to fail.

Expanded the map of the Lakeside Lodge.

Fishing is now available at the Lakeside Lodge.

Fixed the bug of incorrect calculation of water wave light and shadow at the Lakeside Lodge.

Buildings in the Back Mountain can now swap positions using the bird's - eye view.

Optimized the performance of the Qiankun Bag panel.

Significantly optimized the algorithm consumption for moving objects on the Qiankun Bag panel.

Significantly optimized the click algorithm for removing plants on the Qiankun Bag panel.

Added a plant - removal function to the panel of the Qiankun Bag. Now, you can remove crops using the bird's - eye view.

Fixed the bug where the interaction buttons didn't disappear correctly after exiting the Qiankun Bag.

Enlarged the adsorption judgment range of pick - up items.

Optimized the interface for moving buildings in the countryside. Now, the icons of plants and items are appropriately reduced in size.

Fixed the bug where the task reward of 20 jars of honey for the novice task 23 (recruit a beekeeper) might not be picked up correctly.

Fixed the bug where the novice tasks 38 and 39 (obtain high - quality fish catches) could be completed even when catching trash.

Slightly increased the basic value of all fish catches.

Optimized the rendering effect of the sea surface.

Fixed the bug where the collectible "Trash Storage Box" didn't work.

Fixed the bug where the collectible "Trash Storage Box" fails to work under special circumstances.

Now, the crafting panel of the research bench can be interacted with using keyboard keys and the gamepad.

Now, the teleportation panel of the teleportation staff can be interacted with using keyboard keys and the gamepad.

Rewrote the original key - interaction logic of the store page and fixed the bug where key - interaction fails in some cases (in special stores).

Added 6 new novice tasks.

Expanded the list of villagers' commission tasks. Now, some villagers will issue tasks that require fish catches.

Appropriately increased the monetary rewards for completing villagers' commissions.

Added price fluctuations for the fish catch category in the shipping box.

Optimized the menu interface for switching the current production/manufacturing of buildings in the manual panel. Now, when there is a large number of target menus displayed, it is more convenient to select the target, and the number of target buttons displayed per page has been increased.

Fixed the plant texture error in the scene of a bundle of blueberries.

Fixed the UI error of a bundle of eggplant seeds.

Added 3 types of handmade fishing baits that can be crafted at the research bench. These handmade fishing baits have unique effects.

Added an introductory story for the seaside fish catch NPC.

In the manual panel, a feature has been added where you can click on the building where a villager is currently working to directly jump to the building details page.

Optimized the situation where when there are multiple beds in the home, the married partner will preferentially look for a double bed instead of a single bed.

A filtering button has been added to the crafting interface of the research bench.

Now, the French fries stand on the right side of the linen store by the seaside also sells "Slow - cooked Seafood Delicacies". "Slow - cooked Seafood Delicacies" provides a fishing buff of level 2. You can buy "Slow - cooked Seafood Delicacies" twice a day.

Fixed the bug where random NPC tasks on the street sometimes wrongly consume items of higher quality. Now, if items of higher levels are consumed, an extra money - multiplier reward will be given.

Added the UI for coconuts.

Added sea shrimps, which can be caught by the seaside.

Added career statistics for starfish and sea shrimps in the manual.

Slightly increased the pickup range of dropped items.

Fixed the display bug of the recruitment efficiency of the tavern on the building details page in the manual.

Upgraded the buff levels provided by several fish dishes. Dragon Well Shrimps additionally provide a fishing buff.

Fixed the display bug in the fish information in the manual where there are extra commas in the season part.

Starfish can now be picked up at the seaside.

Starfish can now be caught by fishing at the seaside.

Optimized the appearance of the seaside aquarium construction site.

In the villager menu of the manual, villagers without jobs will be displayed at the top.

In the villager menu of the manual, villagers without jobs will be highlighted in red.

Fixed the bug that caused the cooking panel to misjudge the material quality when consuming materials. Now it can judge materials of all levels and preferentially consume materials of lower levels, whether they are in the backpack or in the warehouse.

Modified the display rule of the remaining material quantity on the cooking panel. Now it shows the sum of materials of all levels in the backpack and the warehouse.

Fixed the bug that the remaining material quantity was not correctly refreshed after cooking.

Fixed the bug that occurs when making dishes when some materials are in the backpack and some are in the warehouse.

The warehouse has added a fish screening category.

Two new fish dishes have been added.

Now, when the fish are concentrated, you won't catch trash anymore.

A new buff has been added: Fishing (increases the probability of getting a bite and obtaining high-quality fish).

A new collectible has been added to Wuling's Favorability Store: Wuling's Teapot.

Fixed the bug that allowed you to catch special fish that don't belong to the current season.

Fixed the bug that caused the game to freeze when fishing failed.

Fixed a bug where the waves would freeze and not play their animation.

Fixed a bug where animated objects would not play their animations.

Fixed a bug where the tables in the fish store would disappear unexpectedly in the afternoon.

Fixed a bug where the preview price was incorrect when selecting collectibles in Yama's seaside store.

Optimized the situation where, under special circumstances, players could move to areas of their homes that were not allowed.

Optimized and correctly modified some English texts.

Fixed a bug where the minimap showed the player's position incorrectly when the player was at the seaside.

Modified the completion condition of the collectible achievement to 50 pieces.

Fixed a bug in the fishing trigger point of the town canal.

Fixed a bug that would cause abnormal random customer positions in the commercial street after the recruitment was completed.

Attempted to fix the situation where a black screen freeze would occur with a small probability when recruiting salespersons. (If this bug still occurs, please let me know in the Steam discussion area, and it would be best if you could describe the detailed situation.)

Now, when loading the game, the scene data of the commercial street will be preloaded.
Fixed the bug where it would wrongly rain indoors in the player's own house at the start of a new day.

Added UI display effects to the daily settlement process. Now, it will prompt the progress of the current settlement in real time.

Modified the UI display of the item consumption and expenditure parts in the settlement panel.

In the villager details page in the manual, their corresponding residences will now be additionally marked.

All villagers' addresses are now marked on the mini-map.

Fixed the bug that allowed some relatively large furniture (such as a 3x5 table) to be placed in the middle of a wall.

Fixed the bug that the calendar decoration would block mouse clicks.

Fixed the bug that all wall decorations would sometimes display with incorrect layer orders.
Fixed the bug that prevented entering a new day due to the unimplemented system. We are terribly sorry.

Fixed the issue where the game would display a black screen when opened due to damaged save files caused by unexpected exits.
Now you can continue the game by loading the last intact save file.

Fixed an issue where the performance optimization feature for the Back Mountain would cause the game to freeze when repeatedly entering the Back Mountain.

Fixed a bug where the portable warehouse talent button would not refresh correctly when starting a new save.

Optimized the collision boundaries on the first floor of the Northern Restaurant to prevent players from getting stuck in certain corners.

Fixed a bug where deleting a recipe would cause buildings using that recipe to get stuck in the settlement process.

Optimized the UI display effects of the handbook panel.

Fixed a bug where starting a new game could incorrectly read and save erroneous data.

Added text prompts to the save panel.

Optimized the beginner task for cleaning up farm debris.

Added keyboard arrow key controls for character movement.

Added key input and controller support for the task reading panel.

Added button shortcuts to the settings panel in the handbook.

Players can now preview the contents of all villagers' affinity shops in the villagers' page of the handbook.

Optimized Wen Tao's morning reading action position to facilitate player interaction.

Optimized the collision on the right side of Wen Tao's house.

Fixed a bug where the map grid preview layer was incorrect when placing sprinklers.

Fixed incorrect arrow direction on the save file loading panel.

Fixed a bug where Linseed did not appear correctly at the Northern Country Restaurant after 6 PM.
Fixed the issue where the UI panels for the backpack, decoration, farm teleport, and farm transportation did not support 21:10 or ultrawide screen resolutions.

Fixed a bug where custom keybindings would not work after loading a saved game.

Added support for keyboard and gamepad inputs on the task delegation page.

Game roadmap now includes hints about the required villager professions for each building.

Removing light fixtures will refund all spent gold.

Confirmation panels now have a 0.3-second cooldown to prevent accidental touches.

Added a new beginner task to open the game roadmap.

If there are no villagers available to work in a specific building, a prompt will display the required villager profession for that building.

Added extra floating prompt effects for health recovery and health deduction.

Added extra floating prompt effects when picking up items.

Fixed a bug with the flax 4-heart affection storyline.

Optimized performance in the back mountain area with a large number of buildings. Even with hundreds of map tiles, performance is no longer affected. (New features may cause bugs, please report any issues in the Steam discussion forum, and I will try to fix them as soon as I see them.)

Fixed a bug where tasks related to storing items in the warehouse might not be completed correctly.

Fixed a bug where players could spawn at strange locations after fainting.

Fixed a bug where item rewards for beginner tasks were missing the reward description text.

Fixed a bug where loading a saved file could cause the task panel to display incorrectly.

Modified the time limit for triggering the commercial street construction storyline (now adjusted to be all day, preventing players from failing to trigger the storyline correctly when first entering the commercial street).

Adjusted the trigger sequence of some beginner tasks.

Fixed a bug where, in case of fainting, the player might wake up at an incorrect location.

Added operating hours to each shop on the mini-map

Fixed a bug where extra reward items on the task commission panel displayed incorrect "X" letters.

Added more types of part-time job and action-based commission tasks. The total number of current commission tasks is 92.

Added more tutorial tasks.

Fixed a bug where the task panel in the top left corner did not refresh correctly after accepting a task.

A new task bulletin board has been added in the town.

Each villager will post unique commission tasks, which can be accepted through the task bulletin board.

Many different villager commission tasks have been designed. Once the commission conditions are met, talk to the villager to hand over the task and receive the reward.

Fixed a bug where additional decorative items on the bedroom table were not properly recycled when items on the table were removed. Now, the decorative items will be correctly and automatically returned to the warehouse.

Fixed an issue where, in certain circumstances, the beginner guide tasks would get stuck on a specific task and not proceed to the next task (please try completing the task again to proceed smoothly).

Fixed a bug where the task system data would not refresh correctly when loading a save.

Optimized the UI button for collapsing the task panel.

The villager bulletin board's commission system is expected to be updated within two days.

Added a feature to freely resize the window in windowed mode.

Fixed a bug where using the shortcut key to water plants could cause the game to freeze.

Fixed a bug where sprinklers wouldn't work correctly after loading a different save file.

Save file reading and starting a new game in a new save slot. You can now read saved files via the manual => settings => save panel, but please note that unsaved content from the current day will be lost when loading a save. The game will automatically save to the corresponding save slot when a new day starts. (This feature is independent of the auto backup save function, which only backs up the data in the auto save slot).

Added an interactive option to open the calendar panel for the indoor calendar furniture.

Fixed an issue where changing the village name in the manual panel would conflict with other hotkeys.

Fixed a bug where buildings could be placed in restricted areas while building on the farm.

Fixed a bug where footstep water splash effects and player reflections would incorrectly appear indoors.

Fixed a bug where the spouse could not be correctly located in the new house after marriage.

Fixed a bug where the spouse could not find a sleeping spot in the new house after marriage.

Attempted fix for the bug that occurs when setting up the tavern employee.

Optimized the placement conditions for furniture on walls.

Optimized the footprint size of a cabinet.

Fixed a bug where indoor light fixtures could not be correctly removed.

Optimized the text descriptions for some tasks, making them more detailed.

Optimized the loading speed at the start of the game.

Added UI animations when tasks are completed while the task interface is hidden.

Added animation for the task expand button.

Optimized task completion conditions for tasks 8, 12, 14, 22, 24, and 26. Tasks related to building constructions will now additionally check if the building has already been constructed.

If you have any further questions or feedback, please let me know through the Steam discussion forum. I will reply and try to solve any issues as soon as I see them.
Fixed some wallpaper display misalignment issues

Updated the new task guide system. A series of initial guide tasks have been added, making the early gameplay transition smoother for players.

Initial stamina is now set to 100 points (the task system will provide more stamina food).

Changed the appearance condition of the gambling vagabond to after the seventh day of the game.

Now, all construction sites can be continuously built by holding down the button.

Fixed a bug where the decoration panel would display conflicting and repeated prompts.

Fixed a bug where two large wall cabinets did not have colliders.

Fixed layer order errors on several furniture cabinets.

Optimized the backpack expand animation.

Adjusted the position of the Buff display bar to accommodate the quest system.

Fixed a bug where the bedroom might incorrectly be affected by weather effects when reopening the game.

Added an additional prompt during indoor expansion, requiring players to switch to the corresponding layout mode in order to remove walls, furniture, or flooring.

Fixed an issue where the new indoor scenes were incorrectly affected by weather effects.

Indoor expansions will now correctly be influenced by the 'Space Cube' collectible.

Fixed a bug where the Qiankun Bag UI wouldn't hide when other panels were opened.

Fixed an incorrect default anchor point for the description display in the player handbook panel.

Optimized the display effects of the backpack panel, player handbook panel, and building detail page.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the object for the Cooking Festival was incorrectly displayed in front of the Northern Restaurant.

The warehouse panel can now fully accept keyboard and gamepad inputs!! (The feature for selecting filter buttons with the gamepad is still in development)

The game roadmap will now display correctly at a 2560*1600 resolution.

The game roadmap can now properly accept keyboard and gamepad input commands.

The renovation panel can now correctly accept gamepad input commands to scroll through the furniture list.

The furniture on the renovation panel will now display the correct quantity.

Fixed a bug where, without restarting the game, a bug could be triggered upon entering the Dragon Boat Festival scene for the second time.

Fixed a bug where, without restarting the game, some villagers might not display correctly upon entering the cooking festival for the second time.

The button to exit from being stuck will now correctly reset its cooldown every day.

Fixed a bug where all panels displayed incorrectly at 2560*1600 resolution.

The main menu can now correctly accept both keyboard and controller inputs.

The left joystick in the backpack interface can now quickly move the selection box, while the D-pad moves the selection box one step at a time.

Changed the shortcut keys for switching major functions in the manual panel (L2, R2 trigger buttons).

Optimized the UI of the L button.

The recipe, villagers, and building pages in the manual panel now correctly display controller button prompts (correctly distinguishing between PS and Xbox controllers).

Optimized the scroll bar refresh method in the manual for player-crafted recipes. Now, deleting a recipe will not reset the scroll bar parameters.
Optimized the implementation of certain glowing effect UIs in the manual panel. They will now be correctly affected by masking.
Fixed a bug where some tables and low cabinets couldn’t interact properly, preventing the placement of decorative items (such as vases).
Added a virtual mouse function. Now, when a controller is connected, the virtual mouse will be correctly recognized (some functions and panels can only be interacted with via the virtual mouse, such as the talent panel and furniture decoration panel, so after a long and difficult development process, this feature has been implemented).
All interactive function bars will now correctly display the corresponding controller buttons (correctly showing Xbox and PlayStation buttons).
The building and planting functions will now automatically detect whether a controller is connected and switch to controller planting mode.
You can now switch between controller planting mode or cursor tracking mode while planting or building.
The manual/backpack/building details/shop now fully accept controller input and distinguish between Xbox and PlayStation controllers.
I will gradually create button prompts for each panel, please be patient.
Controller support is not completely finished yet, for example, the warehouse panel still does not fully support controller input, but you can interact with it using the virtual cursor. I will continue to optimize the controller interaction experience.
The underlying version of the engine has been upgraded, so there may be unexpected bugs. If any bugs arise, I will fix them as soon as possible.

Added Dragon Boat Festival race (held on the 15th of Summer).

Added reminder email for the Dragon Boat Festival.

Added 5-star Villager Promotion Certificate (reward for first place in the Dragon Boat race).

Added War Drum collectible (reward for first place in the Dragon Boat race, increases player movement speed).

Specialty Store now sells wine.

Adjusted scroll speed of the manual panel's mouse wheel.

Increased the selling price of the Magic Sauce in the specialty store.

Optimized the colliders for the Milk Tea Shop, Recruitment Tavern, Ramen Shop, and Specialty Store, making them "smoother."

Added a loading delay and a cooldown time to the building swapping function to prevent accidental issues caused by rapid clicking.

Now, when adding a recipe from the compendium to the research panel, it will correctly reset first to prevent bugs in certain situations.

Corrected the text error for Dream Oil.

Fixed a bug where certain map tiles in the back mountain would cause occlusion issues.

Tea seed oil is now correctly categorized as a tea-related product.

Fixed a bug where fertilizer was not being consumed correctly.
