Fixed a bug where the advanced research station only worked for blueprints and not for other crafting.

Fixed a bug where the housing information for the first cabin given at the start of the game was not properly recorded.

Optimized the algorithm for the "Restart Game" button.

Optimized the backup save mechanism. In addition to the original system that backed up every 10 minutes, it now also includes separate backups every 5 minutes and every 15 minutes to better manage and prevent unforeseen issues. To restore a backup, open the save location from the game start menu, find the desired backup (labeled "BackupSave5min," "BackupSave10min," or "BackupSave15min"), back up the current "Save_Current," delete the original "Save_Current," and move the backup file to the original save location.
Improved the display of remaining money and prosperity value on the store page.
Optimized the display of total income figures on the settlement panel.
Fixed a bug where splitting limited items incorrectly reset the expiration date for limited goods.
New feature: In the backpack interface, you can now directly swap the position of items by selecting one item and right-clicking on another.
Fixed a bug that could occur when using the town's building swap feature.

Added a new feature: You can now open an aerial view by approaching commercial buildings to swap building positions and layouts.
Optimized the player movement control: Now, you can continuously move by just pressing the button, without needing to release and press the direction key again after stopping.
Updated the descriptions and names of all rose sale recipes to prevent misunderstandings.
The scrollbar in the settlement panel will now display correctly.
Optimized the scroll speed of the mouse wheel in the specific submenus of the building detail page.
Optimized the end process of the Cooking Festival to prevent potential freezing issues.
Improved the sorting algorithm in the recruitment interface for candidates. Now they are sorted by rarity and ability value.
Added a "Escape from Stuck" button in the Manual => Settings panel (use it to reset the character's state when stuck, but it can only be used once per day).
Fixed a bug that could cause recruitment to fail

Modified the hotkey for teleporting through interactions with farm obstacles to prevent accidental activation.
Fixed a bug where the tea brewing sound effect during the Mid-Autumn Festival was not affected by distance.
Optimized a bug where the backpack description might not display completely in Japanese.
Improved the display of backpack descriptions in Chinese.
Optimized the item description for the rose sale recipe.
Improved the colliders and triggers for all indoor staircases.
Enhanced the appearance of indoor staircases going down to make them more noticeable.
Adjusted some indoor colliders and decorative placements to allow smoother movement for players inside buildings.
Optimized the collider at the entrance to the Black Market.
Optimized the colliders of all fences in the town.
Fixed a bug related to the display layer of some town buildings.
Increased the price of the Golden Contract Certificate and Forced Recruitment Certificate and raised the probability of them appearing in the Black Market and with the traveling merchant.
Fixed a bug where wanderers might not correctly move into the cabin (does not affect existing wanderers).
Fixed a potential bug when fireworks were played during New Year's Eve.

Added the Mid-Autumn Festival, which can be attended on the evening of the 15th of Autumn in front of the Northern Restaurant.

Added a new feature where, during festivals that start in the evening, you can interact with any locked door to fast-forward time to the festival start.

Added a reminder email for the Mid-Autumn Festival.

Now you can bind the interaction key to the right mouse button, middle mouse button, and side buttons. You can change the key bindings in the manual or settings on the right side of the 'Change Key' button.

Now the traveling merchant Sophia also has a low chance to refresh with a Golden Contract Certificate.

Fixed a bug where leaving the villa without sleeping would cause an incorrect teleportation point.

Fixed a bug where the tea egg grandma's golden egg collectible would trigger repeatedly.

Fixed a bug where the settlement panel information would display blank if opened on the first day of the game or in older versions.

Optimized the save mechanism for the Goddess Shop and Black Market.

Setting buildings, villagers, and functions in the manual will no longer force a refresh of the UI canvas.
Optimized the character illustrations of Wentao, Banxia, and Haitang.
Added a new feature to the settlement panel, which now shows the production and consumption difference statistics, making it easier for players to identify gaps in large supply chains.
You can now view the previous day's settlement information anytime in the manual.
Added a countdown timer prompt to the mail panel to prevent accidental exits.

Fixed a bug where number keys were not functioning when remapping keybindings.
Refactored the sprinkler range display algorithm. Now, the range is only displayed correctly when planting or placing sprinklers, and it is no longer affected by the character's or mouse's position.
Fixed a bug where planting would incorrectly reset the mouse position in certain situations.

Redesigned all villagers' gift dialogue and modified various daily and affection dialogues for villagers (thanks to Chan for the excellent copywriting support).
Fixed a bug with the recipe count statistics in the manual's sewing shop panel.
Increased the sales quantities for pink diamond necklaces and pink diamond rings.
Fixed a bug where a forced recruitment certificate incorrectly affected the cost to lock villagers

Fixed a bug caused by widescreen support that led to incorrect anchor point display on the recipe guide panel. This issue caused the recipe development tutorial to not display or skip properly. We apologize for the inconvenience.
Fixed a bug where the quantity of the selected dish did not reset to 1 when switching between dishes in the cooking interface.

Currently using Unity's control layout system combined with in-game interfaces to implement controller controls. (You need to download the community layout controller scheme. I will gradually shift focus to game content creation, while optimizing controller support will continue in my spare time.)
Fixed a bug where exiting the villa bedroom would incorrectly place the character at the farm.
Optimized part of the gift-giving code to prevent a rare data corruption bug during gift-giving.
To prevent display errors, the sprinkler range will no longer listen to mouse movement.

All UI panels now support widescreen (ultrawide) resolutions. (If any panels are still not displaying correctly, please let me know.)
The shop page now displays a scroll bar to make it easier to navigate long shop lists.
The teleport staff can now transport you to the villa (you need to obtain the key first).
Fixed a bug where the teleportation panel couldn't be dragged to the bottom.
Fixed a bug where the manual panel would still listen to keyboard input when editing villager and recipe names.
Fixed an issue where the sprinkler range would still be displayed even after the character walked out of range.
Disabled some redundant interactions between the left mouse button and the "Q" key. Now, primary keyboard interactions remain, while mouse interactions are preserved for building and chopping trees.
Fixed some bugs related to the display of Japanese text.
Fixed an error in the Japanese text for mushrooms.

Fixed a bug with incorrect placeholders in the Golden Egg collectible dialogue.
Fixed a bug where random request events would ask for the wrong dish.
Fixed a bug with incorrect hiding of the achievement screen; achievements now no longer trigger a popup notification.
Fixed an issue where the Goddess Shop page allowed the purchase of already obtained collectibles.
Completely refactored all underlying input code to support both Xbox and PS controllers by switching to Unity's new Input System. Please report any input-related bugs you encounter. We apologize for any inconvenience!
Fully implemented keyboard and controller navigation for the shop page (supports both PS and Xbox controllers; controller button prompt icons are still in development).
I will continue to work on controller support, with just a few challenges remaining.

Rewrote the scythe collectible's bulk harvesting feature and optimized the performance of the bulk harvesting algorithm.
Fixed an issue where the plant growth cycle was one day longer than described and expected due to a miscalculation, and clarified the ambiguous descriptions.
Now, the scythe collectible effect will also trigger when stealing crops in the town.
The key hint bar on the right side will now correctly recognize game controller input and show the appropriate controller button prompts (PS controller support will be added later).
Villager dialogue boxes will correctly display controller buttons.
Fixed a bug where diagonal movement would slow down when using a connected controller.

The manual panel now fully supports keyboard input for navigation and control!
Changed the sprinkler's collision shape to an ellipse.
Adjusted the base stat requirement for Zen Tea House recipes to 0, allowing wanderers to properly reside there and train their skills.
Fixed the issue where the minimize and maximize buttons on the talent panel had reversed parameters.

Adjusted the growth cycles and drop quantities of all crops, significantly shortening the growth periods while slightly reducing drop amounts to improve the planting experience and rewards for players who plant manually.
The North Country Restaurant now accepts work starting at 9 AM.
Fixed a bug where pressing "R" on the recipe page in the manual would not scroll through recipe types.
The villager and town resident interfaces in the manual can now be fully navigated using the keyboard.
Interactions within scenes can now be done using a game controller (some parts are completed, others are still in progress).

Added a feature to lock a recruitable villager in the tavern. You can spend one-tenth of the recruitment cost to lock them for a day, ensuring they remain on the recruitable list the next day.
Added the collectible item "Golden Egg."
Fixed a bug where the option to roll the dice would still be displayed even with an average of 5 dice already rolled.

In construction mode, you can now see the specific watering range when near a sprinkler.
Increased grape yield due to the large footprint of the grape trellis.
Fixed some conflicts between mouse logic and keyboard input in the manual's functionality.

Fixed a bug where fragrant mushrooms could still be sold to the black market even on Thursdays.
Added a button to open the save folder.
The manual's encyclopedia section can now be fully navigated using the keyboard.
The player's recipe section in the manual can now be switched using keyboard input.
Fixed a bug where some villager talents were not working correctly.

Added eggplant as a new crop. Seeds can be purchased from the general store.
Implemented part of the key input system for the Career Mode section in the handbook panel. (Continued work on adding input functionality to the handbook panel.)

Fixed a bug where the floor in indoor corridors might not display correctly.
Fixed a bug where sorting items in the warehouse could duplicate items.
Fixed a bug where the building details panel would incorrectly appear the moment a building was completed.
Added a quantity selection input and new selection buttons to the betting mini-game panel.
Now, even in a tie in the betting mini-game, you can choose to continue rolling the dice until a loss occurs.

Added partial support for key input on the handbook panel (Overview and Settings panels).
Significantly increased rice yield.
Greatly expanded the detection range for automatic watering.
Added a tooltip to display dice points.
Changed grape harvest cycle to once every 3 days.
Fixed a bug where the price of baijiu in the specialty store was incorrect.
Fixed a bug where consumable items could be placed in the betting mini-game.
Fixed a bug where married players could continue gifting marriage tree branches to others.

Adjusted the sorting algorithm for the inventory and warehouse; items will now be sorted by type and relevance.
Added a left-side click selection box to the teleport panel of the Tianya Zhi Chi Mirror, making it easier to switch quickly between many teleport nodes.
Added more teleport nodes to the Teleport Staff.
Now, after collecting the 4-piece set of legendary kitchenware, you can see the detailed countdown for cooking.

Added the ability to hold down "Ctrl" to slow down movement.
Fixed a bug where giving high-star dishes as gifts to villagers could cause item removal errors.
Now, when gifting high-star dishes to villagers, they provide additional affection bonuses.
Added a new filter for "Decoration Items" in the warehouse.

Fixed some bugs in the collectible lottery system.
Fixed a model layering bug on the first floor of the Northern Restaurant.
Rolled back the handbook feature where switching buildings no longer forcibly returns to the top, as this feature currently has a bug.
Fixed a clipping issue on the 3rd floor of the general store.
Optimized some indoor collision detection.
Fixed a display layering error for some stamina fruits.

Fixed a bug where Ziyuan did not dislike nutrient soil.
Added a new collectible, Chainsaw: No more debris will appear when unlocking new plots on the farm (can be obtained from the black market lottery).
The decoration panel now displays the remaining number of furniture.
Hovering over items in the decoration panel will now display the item name.
Fixed a bug where, in extremely large town map blocks, the map would become invisible.

Now, the building details page can be fully controlled using keyboard inputs!
Modified the prompt description when removing commercial street buildings.
Adjusted the collision box for the convenience store and the stamina fruit location in the 2nd-floor crane game room of the family restaurant.
Removed some favorite items from villagers that cannot currently be obtained through normal means.
When switching buildings in the handbook, it will no longer forcibly return to the top.
Increased the scroll speed of the teleport panel for the "Heavenly Mirror of Boundaries.

Added a description about "likes" in the handbook panel to help players understand the mechanism.
Introduced a limit to the number of customers on the commercial street.
Fixed a bug where, on particularly large maps, the camera could not capture objects on the corresponding Z-axis.

Adjusted the construction costs for commercial buildings.
Fixed a bug where baijiu (white liquor) could not be placed in the research panel.
Fixed a bug where upgrading a villager's star (in cases of high ability for wanderers) would cause ability stats to decrease instead.
Fixed a bug where estimated prices were not displayed for jewelry shop and fashion shop recipes.
Fixed a bug where the prices in the jewelry and fashion shops differed from expected values.
Fixed a bug where objects could not be captured by the camera when the map expanded to an exceptionally large size (over 200 tiles).
Fixed a bug where collectible draws would still deduct attempts even if the prosperity points were insufficient.
Added a limit to black market collectible draws: once all available collectibles have been drawn, you can no longer continue drawing.

I have received a significant amount of player feedback regarding issues with broken game balance in the later stages. In this version, I will be adjusting the following values:

I will not be adjusting villager wages, but the satiety provided by luxury and high-end food will be relatively reduced (you’ll need to provide more luxury food to high-star villagers, but not by much—e.g., from 3 portions to 4 or from 10 to 13).

The recruitment price for high-rarity, high-ability villagers has been increased. Players will need more time to gather the money needed to recruit these villagers.

The recipe system has been modified. You can still customize recipes to be upwardly compatible with one extra ingredient (e.g., the 'First Love' recipe is milk + tea leaves + any other ingredient), but the extra ingredient must now be edible—non-edible materials like iron ingots or diamonds are no longer allowed.

The sales multiplier for custom recipes will be adjusted. It will now increase or decrease based on the value of the additional ingredients relative to the base recipe value. This means using cheaper materials will slightly increase sales quantity, while using expensive ingredients will reduce sales quantity.

The unit price for certain items has been lowered: diamonds, pink diamonds, truffles, silver rings, gold bracelets, silver necklaces, gem earrings, diamond rings, jade bracelets, diamond necklaces, pink diamond rings, pink diamond necklaces, seafood, Dreamwine, Elixir, Deep Valley Orchid, Deep Valley Perfume, ramen broth, and hotpot base.

The price of specialty store products has been adjusted.

The total sales quantity for the entire commercial street has been slightly reduced.

The display of work efficiency in the building details has been updated (satisfaction of 120 or above provides 150% work efficiency).
Fixed a bug where the shop input prompt would appear above the confirmation panel.
All alcoholic beverages are now categorized as food and can be consumed.
Drinking Dreamwine now grants the 'Eureka' status.
Reduced the yield of Deep Valley Orchids in the greenhouse and plantation.
Fixed a display bug that occurred when town expansion exceeded 115 times.
Fixed a bug where crops could be stolen in the void during winter.
Fixed a bug where rapidly clicking buttons during recruitment could cause incorrect panel displays.
Fixed an overlap bug between Cherry and Sedum on the 2nd floor of the Chinese medicine shop at night.
Fixed an overlap issue where Jasmine and Sedum would share a bench at certain times.
Fixed a bug where money exceeding 2.1 billion surpassed the limit of the 'int' type. The maximum amount of coins is now capped at 9 trillion.

When the backpack is full and you have the portable warehouse talent, excess items will go directly to the warehouse.
The Golden Tree can now be correctly recycled.
Added a feature to the backpack interface where the keyboard input selection box only appears when a key is pressed.
Improved keyboard input functionality on the backpack interface.
Added key prompts for keyboard input in the backpack interface.
Added key prompts for keyboard input on the shop page.
Modified the items that Cherry loves.

Farm stumps now drop hardwood.
Increased the amount of wood and hardwood dropped from trees in the back mountains.
Modified the filtering categories for some items.
Changed the item type for some sauces.
Reclassified all flowers as crops.
Fixed a bug where villager work efficiency could exceed 150%.
Fixed a bug where the gift amount was displayed incorrectly when starting the recruitment minigame (the actual consumption was correct, only the display was wrong).
The blueprint drawing panel now allows skipping with a left mouse click when creating farm construction blueprints.
Reclassified Deep Valley Orchid, coffee beans, and cocoa as crops.
Coffee beans and cocoa have been added to the plant statistics in the manual.
Fixed a bug where the highest-tier Black Market lottery could occasionally get stuck.

A Yin-Yang Pill has been added to the goddess's shop. Taking it will change your gender, so please use it with caution.
Added an animation effect for the Golden Tree when collecting fruits.
Further optimized the algorithms for saving and illuminating recipes.
Fixed a bug where duplicate recipe detection errors led to incorrect saves (normal players should not encounter this).
Further fixed the bug with the third tier of Black Market lottery collectibles.
Fixed a display error for the first-place collectible reward in the Winter Cooking Festival (the actual unlock is correct; the correct collectible will be automatically obtained after sleeping).
Fixed a clipping bug in the Chinese Medicine Shop.
Fixed numerous collision bugs.

Lava Fruit seeds are now available for purchase in the grocery store (unlocked at Town Level 5), but a bundle of Lava Fruit seeds can still only be bought from the Claw Machine Store.
Fixed a bug where the 5000-tier (third level) Black Market lottery couldn't draw permanent collectibles.
Slightly increased the prosperity points required for the first and second tiers of Black Market collectible lotteries.
Fixed a bug where the prosperity points displayed in the top right corner of shops were incorrect.
Fixed a bug where under certain conditions, researching a recipe could be saved repeatedly to the local file, causing the entire dictionary file to crash.
Now, when adding recipes locally, duplicate checking will be performed to prevent unexpected errors.
Fixed some collision errors.
Fixed certain clipping bugs on the 3rd floor of the Northland Restaurant.

The manual now allows for quick switching of the villagers working in buildings! (Temporarily not supported for the tavern, as removing villagers from the tavern will cause all recruitable villagers there to disappear. I'll continue working on the tavern so it can also support switching.)
The Golden Tree has been created! It can be purchased from the goddess's shop. Once placed on the farm, it can be interacted with once per day to collect all the fruit trees and grapes.
Fixed a collision bug in the Peony and Aster sisters' bedroom.
Fixed an incorrect display layering bug in the Banxia storyline.
Lowered the price of some seed bundles.
Fixed a bug where stealing crops would result in negative affection from villagers.
Fixed a bug caused by excessive audio sources leading to sound issues.
Fixed a bug where changing background music volume in the manual had no effect.
Reduced the sales multiplier for Hangover Remedy.
Increased the sales multiplier for Passionate Inferno.

Fixed a bug where the dialogue image of random roadside purchase NPCs would appear above the inventory layer.
Fixed a bug where villagers' talents incorrectly displayed visual effects when viewed in the manual.
Fixed a bug where the seed reminder email would trigger repeatedly.

Fixed a bug that caused players to be unable to start a new day due to incorrect plant information.
Fixed a bug when calculating the Statistician achievement, which now triggers correctly (if the conditions are met, the achievement will automatically unlock the next day).
Modified the way collectible counts are displayed in the statistics page; it now shows correctly.
Fixed a bug where repeated conversations with the goddess in a short time could cause the game to freeze.
Fixed a bug where the goddess displayed the luck level as one tier lower than the actual level.
Fixed a bug where the Phoenix Knife could cause the dish quality to exceed the upper limit.
The wedding achievement will now automatically be judged during the next day's settlement.
Added a new anti-freeze measure to the daily settlement system.
Fixed a bug where the total number of dishes and recipes in the statistics screen was one more than the actual count.

Added a major new feature: you can now switch the production/processing target of buildings in the manual (there may be bugs; if you encounter any, please report them to me, and I will fix them as soon as possible).
Fixed a bug where the talent count was incorrect in the data statistics page.
Added 4 new collectibles, which can be obtained by winning first place in the cooking festival. Each provides different effects for cooking.
Fixed a bug that allowed incorrect player movement during the cooking festival.
Fixed a bug where the Northland would repeat dialogue when submitting dishes during the cooking festival.
Optimized the display of time in the itinerary. Some times like x:60 will now display as x+1:00.
Fixed a bug where the wrong conditions were required to unlock cooking achievements.
Fixed a bug where the mail notification icon would disappear incorrectly.
Added additional safety measures when saving system files to prevent rare cases of save file corruption.
Added 4 new collectibles to the inventory collection interface and changed it to a scrollable mode.
Adjusted the priority for triggering the wedding event to avoid conflict with other festivals; weddings will now be postponed.
Fixed bugs with the layering order of multi-room houses, as well as clipping issues.
Increased the minimum yield for rice.
The gambling mini-game will now randomly offer Starfruit seeds and Deep Valley Orchid seeds.
The black market will also randomly offer Starfruit seeds and Deep Valley Orchid seeds (with low probability).
Updated the description of powerful fertilizer to avoid misunderstanding.
Fixed a bug where the price of tungsten ore was incorrect.
Fixed missing output items in the game route map for the quarry.
Farm construction blueprints can now be collapsed.
Adjusted the weight of the Y-axis for targeting objects.
Fixed a bug where the game would freeze if you tried to give a gift without being close to the NPC

The inventory can now be controlled using keyboard shortcuts: use the spacebar to select items and press "E" to use them.
Further increased the output of the greenhouse to create a greater difference from the plantation.
Continued optimization of town collider issues.
Changed the maximum purchase button in the shop back to its maximum value.
Added a feature where your spouse gives you a dish during the first daily conversation.
Now, talking to a romancable character can sometimes grant a "Sudden Inspiration" buff, ensuring the next recipe research will have a five-star rating.
Increased the value of truffles from 500 to 600.
Adjusted the sorting method for player-created recipes.

A guaranteed mechanism has been added to daily luck, preventing two consecutive days of bad luck.
The sorting method for the recipe manual's catalog has been revised.
Added a description of the minimum quantity to the recipe manual's catalog.
Added post-purchase and purchase-canceling dialogues for random roadside NPCs.
Fixed a bug where the floating dialogue box for random NPCs would incorrectly disappear.

You can now click on the number in the store page to input the purchase quantity.
Fixed a bug where the game would freeze when talking to or gifting villagers right as they switch scenes.
Optimized some of the town's colliders.
Improved the text content of the black market VIP card email.
Refined the description of the "Happy Soup."
You can now skip the animation during recipe research by using the left mouse button or the spacebar.
Custom keys can now be bound to the spacebar.

Accelerated the speed of farming-related actions.
You can now see the villagers' favorite items when gifting, with an additional marker.
Fixed a bug where some of Yingchun's favorite items were displayed incorrectly.
Optimized the work process by removing the black screen text prompts.
Improved the response when clicking to skip the work process.

Added a new feature where there's a chance to reveal a villager's favorite items during conversations.
Added three new dishes to the cooking panel.
Fixed a bug where the floating dialog box for farm machinery would incorrectly disappear.
Fixed a bug where the buttons on the building detail page would not hide properly.
Newly expanded map blocks in the back mountain and farm now correctly display snow.
Fixed a layering issue with the snow in the back mountain.
Fixed text errors in the Winter Cooking Festival awards.
Fixed some process errors in the Cooking Festival.
Lowered the required skill values for Alloy Ingot, Tungsten Ingot, and Gold Ingot.
Added Evening Primrose Oil, Platycodon Oil, Lavender Oil, and Dream Mist, which can be produced in the Brewing Factory.
These four oils can also be sold at the Specialty Store.

Increased the price of custom tea blend recipes.
The research station is now initially placed inside your home.
Fixed a bug where some plant seeds in the greenhouse were consumed incorrectly.
Fixed a bug where you couldn't enter the cherry room even if the required affection level was met.
Work animations can now be skipped with the left mouse button or the spacebar.
Fixed a bug where winter crops couldn't be harvested correctly when using powerful fertilizer.
Trees on the farm will now become semi-transparent when approached from behind, no longer obstructing the view.

Roadside random NPC dialogues can now be sped up or skipped by clicking with the mouse or pressing the spacebar.
Fixed a bug where it was still possible to dismiss the bartender even when there was only one bartender remaining.
When no bartenders are detected, a special event will be triggered where a wandering bartender will join your village. Please ensure you have at least one wooden cottage ready.
The product details page now displays hints for custom recipes.
Fixed missing collision detection in the upper left area of the farm.
Slightly reduced the amount of debris generated when new farm plots are created.
Optimized the collision detection for town roads.
Fixed incorrect collision detection on some roads in the commercial district.
Updated the building descriptions for tea plantations and beehives to indicate that they do not produce normally during winter.
Fixed a bug where, under certain circumstances, if the required skill values for a recipe exceeded the villagers' current skill values, it would cause the settlement panel to freeze.

Changed all story dialogues to progress to the next line with a key press.
Fixed a bug where the Scholar achievement was not unlocking correctly.
Fixed issues where the dialogue display was suboptimal in certain languages.

Completed the missing recipes for the food processing plant in the game's roadmap.
Fixed an incorrect description for the cacao sapling.
Added a more prominent exit button to the settings panel.
Fixed a bug where, in extremely rare cases, incorrect plant information could prevent the game from progressing to the next day.

Optimized the colliders for commercial buildings such as the town, farm, milk tea shop, recruitment tavern, and specialty store, and removed some objects that were blocking paths.
Adjusted the colliders for the streets in the commercial district.
Modified soybean-related recipes, reducing the number of soybean-related recipes in the reward pool (e.g., stinky tofu semi-finished product, soy sauce, traditional soy sauce, and artificial meat).
Now, the only recipes using soybeans are soy milk and cooking oil (this change does not affect already developed and saved recipes in existing save files).
Corrected the sales volume for some products from the specialty store.
Fixed the pricing error for the specialty store's Lava Chocolate Cake, changing it from 500 to 1200.

Fixed the collider issue with the fish shop.
Fixed a bug where the inventory hotkeys were not functioning.
Sprinklers will now correctly be added to the item filter list in the warehouse.

Fixed a bug where, in the Japanese language setting, the number of Likes required for the next level was displayed incorrectly.
Fixed a bug where the target of the currently selected frame in the inventory panel could not be clicked with the mouse.
Fixed a font size error in the food consumption display in the manual panel.
Adjusted the collider and trigger key positions for farm expansion obstacles.

New Feature:

The inventory panel can now be interacted with using the keyboard! (Specific key prompts will be updated later.)

When moving buildings on the farm, the system will now exclude its own collision box, allowing for small adjustments.

When placing furniture in the home, the player no longer occupies the collision box.

Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where the incorrect food selection was displayed in the recruitment menu under certain language settings.
Fixed the UI display bug for buttons in the recruitment panel.
Corrected the incorrect display of the overview in the manual panel in Japanese.
Fixed a bug where selecting the Golden Certificate could still enter the recruitment process even if there were no houses available.
Modified some text descriptions in the decoration panel.
Fixed an issue where the item types in the inventory interface were not displaying correctly in some language settings.
Fixed a bug where the snow status was not correctly determined when expanding town plots during winter.

Fixed a bug where some letters were triggered under incorrect conditions.
Fixed a bug where the names of the 5 initial villagers given at the start of the game were not generated correctly according to the multilingual environment. Now, the names will be set according to the system language, but this change does not apply to old save files. Players can modify villagers' names through the villagers' menu in the handbook panel for existing saves.
Fixed a bug where the villager recruitment panel was not properly translated.
Made slight adjustments to the dialogue display effects.
The general store now sells corn.
Fixed a bug where an error occurred when directly selecting the function menu without any villagers assigned to a building.
Added some summary information to the function menu of buildings (e.g., warehouse capacity and unit price).
Replaced the Japanese font with a new one.

Fixed a bug where the bulk cooking function on the cooking panel was ineffective.
Fixed a text error where the duration of the Goddess's Blessing was missing from the description.

Completed keyboard input controls for the shop page.
Increased satisfaction provided by villagers' house levels and food levels.
Fixed a bug where English dialogue would incorrectly break lines.
Fixed a bug where consuming a stamina fruit while planting would render the stamina fruit ineffective.
Fixed a bug where clicking on the backpack at the moment of planting would cause the planting to fail.
Fixed a bug where using a stamina fruit through the quick item bar would render it ineffective.

Adjusted the price of some seeds to ensure a better early-game experience for players.
Increased the yield of most crops.
Increased the output of player-researched flour recipes.
Slightly reduced the base quantity of soy milk sales.
Reduced the prosperity points required for all talents.
Fixed a bug where pressing the spacebar or enter key on certain UI panels would incorrectly trigger functions.
Added a small storage box for the home interior, which can also be purchased at the Goddess Shop.

Fixed a bug where villager ability checks were not performed when directly replacing other store recipes.
Fixed a bug that occurred when removing the first building in the town.
Made slight adjustments to the cherry character portrait.
Increased character animation speed to resolve stuttering issues.
Added a new recipe for semi-finished stinky tofu.
Redesigned the UI for vinegar and adjusted the UI for baijiu and huangjiu.
Fixed a bug where the commercial recipes in the handbook sometimes did not display the expected unit price correctly.

Items with unlimited stock in the Goddess Shop can now be purchased in bulk.
Fixed a bug where the prompt text when picking up items had incorrect multilingual configurations.
Added the coffee tree, coffee beans, and coffee-related supply chain recipes.
Coffee tree seeds can now be purchased at the general store.

The images in the planting guide and recipe guide panels now correctly display the corresponding language text.

Fixed some English text errors in the home decoration panel.

Fixed some errors in the research panel when in English.

Fixed an issue where, in some cases, players could not proceed to the next day when near the bed.

The warehouse panel now shows item names when you hover the mouse over them.

Added the cacao tree and chocolate recipe.

The grocery store now sells cacao tree saplings.

Fixed some UI text not displaying the correct language.

Added a prompt for the item swap function in the backpack.

Added a tutorial panel for planting during the newbie guide.

Adjusted the overly low ability requirements for plantations and greenhouses.

Fixed a bug that caused fruit trees to revert to saplings after harvesting.

Corrected Zhongnan's character portrait.

Filled in missing parts of the brewing factory recipes in the game roadmap.

Fixed an issue where, under certain special resolutions, the initial letter page could not be closed, preventing the game from continuing.

Buildings in the commercial street can now select an already occupied recipe, but this will cause another building using that recipe to stop selling.

An additional anti-mistouch feature has been added when retracting farm equipment.

Updated some UI elements.

Added a new pop-up introduction page about recipe development gameplay (normally triggered during Rose's research storyline and will only trigger once).

Fixed a bug where holding the down button when entering the bedroom would cause the player to enter a black zone.
Now, upon reaching the level that unlocks the factory, all metal ingot and chip recipes will be unlocked through mail.
You can now quickly select the last researched recipe when researching new ones.
The obstruction at the bottom of the farm will now become semi-transparent when the player approaches.
The talent system no longer hides talents that haven't been unlocked, allowing players to view the effects of all talents.
Farm processing machines will now prioritize materials in the backpack. If the required materials are not in the backpack, only then will materials from storage be consumed.
Fixed a bug where recruiting villagers at town level 7 would result in an unknown type

notes.title: Small patch
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the default price configuration for the spicy hot pot in the hot pot restaurant was incorrect.

The planting season for rice is now spring, summer, and autumn.
The probability of recruiting personnel with the "Prominent" type has been increased from 50% to 65%.
Fixed a bug where, if you quickly opened the backpack and clicked on other seeds immediately after planting crops, a bug would occur.
Wanderers now have a fixed ability growth cycle of once every 2 days.

Modified some UI elements.
Fixed a bug where the default spicy hot pot recipe in the hot pot restaurant was incorrect.
Fixed a bug where the pre-check price for recruiting villagers was incorrect in certain situations.
Fixed a bug where the bartender talent was not correctly applied when recruiting villagers.
Fixed a bug where the charisma buff was not correctly reducing the recruitment price when recruiting villagers.
From now on, the randomly refreshed recruitable villagers will only appear within the corresponding town level range.
